source_refs.note: 9. Controlling epidemics: a main subheading of 22.1.2 Applications of Biostatistics, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 189-189.

blocks.text: During epidemics, biostatistics is critical in tracking the spread of disease, estimating mortality rates, and identifying at-risk populations. This real-time statistical analysis informs decision-making and helps implement targeted strategies to contain outbreaks and mitigate their effects.
